note: Divorces = civil-affairs REGISTRATIONS ONLY (agreement divorces, subject to the 30-day cooling-off period since 2021); court divorces are NOT included and the 2025 annual bulletin with court divorces is not yet published. Some media wrongly reported 2025 divorces as -770k/-21.9% by comparing 2025 registrations with 2024 total incl. court; registrations actually rose from 2.621 mn (2024) to 2.743 mn.
MHLW vital statistics, 2025 annual preliminary figures (gaisu), published 2026-06-03; Japanese nationals in Japan. 2024: 485,092 marriages (4.0), 185,904 divorces (1.55).

Ministry of Data and Statistics (formerly KOSTAT), 'Marriage and Divorce Statistics in 2025', released 2026-03-19. Official release rounds to 240 thousand / 88 thousand; 240,300 per Korea Times, 88,100 and CMR 4.7 / CDR 1.7 per Seoul Economic Daily and Korea.net. Marriages +8.1%, divorces -3.3%.

C&SD 'Marriage and Divorce Trends in Hong Kong, 1991 to 2024' (Jan 2026). Divorces = divorce decrees granted (Judiciary). C&SD publishes only sex-specific crude marriage rates (2024: males 12.9, females 10.8 per 1000 of same sex), so the total-population rate is null. 2025 marriages already published: 42,242 (C&SD table 115-01015), but 2025 divorce decrees are not yet in table 115-92001, so 2024 is the latest complete year.

Marriage registrations 3,187 from DSEC Demographic Statistics Q4 2024. Rates per 1000 residents from Macao Yearbook 2025 (yearbook.gcs.gov.mo/yearbook_pdf/2025/myb2025cBN05.pdf). Divorce count not published in the retrieved DSEC release; ratio is from the rounded crude rates, so approximate. The 2025 full-year DSEC release exists (gov.mo/en/news/394812) but its marriage/divorce counts could not be retrieved.

Divorces include annulments. SingStat publishes general rates, not crude rates: general marriage rate 39.1 (male) / 38.1 (female) per 1000 unmarried residents aged 15-49; general divorce rate 6.1 (male) / 5.8 (female) per 1000 married residents aged 20+ (data.gov.sg d_6e50a06c6be69b2f72ec0f4ab1cb5d84). 2024: 26,328 marriages, 7,382 divorces+annulments.

DOSM 'Marriages, Divorces and Rujuk Statistics, Malaysia, 2025' (reference year 2024; released Nov 2025). Includes Muslim and non-Muslim marriages and divorces; Muslim share 72.3% of marriages. The next release (reference 2025) is scheduled for 2026-11-19.

No retrievable official national annual marriage/divorce counts or crude rates. Divorces go through the courts, and GSO publishes only provincial 'number of divorces' indicators. The 2024 mid-term census gives a stock, not a flow: about 2.2-2.3 mn divorced/separated persons (2.6% of population aged 15+; urban 2.9%, rural 2.4%). The GSO/MOJ 'National report on civil registration 2021-2024' (nso.gov.vn, Apr 2025) exists but was unreachable.

note: BPS administrative data: marriages from KUA (Muslim) plus Dukcapil (other religions); divorces = court divorce cases (cerai talak + cerai gugat, religious and district courts). No official crude rates published. 2024: 1,478,302 marriages, 399,921 divorces (another outlet cites 394,608).

NO national marriage or divorce registry and no annual flow statistics; crude rates are unavailable. Best credible estimate is a stock measure from Census 2011 (Jacob & Chattopadhyay, EPW 2016): about 1.36 mn divorced persons = 0.24% of the married population (0.11% of total population), and about 3.5 mn separated (0.61% of married). Divorced plus separated is at most about 1% of married couples.

DIVORCE IS NOT LEGAL for non-Muslims (only annulment or declaration of nullity). Muslims may divorce under PD 1083 (Shari'a courts), but no national divorce statistic is published. Marriages -10.2% vs 414,213 in 2023 (CMR 3.7).
ABS 'Marriages and Divorces, Australia, 2025'. Marriages = registered marriages; divorces = divorces granted (Federal Circuit and Family Court). 2024: 120,844 marriages (5.5), 47,216 divorces (2.1).

Marriages include civil unions and cover NZ residents only (444 same-sex). Stats NZ publishes general rates, not crude rates: 7.6 marriages+civil unions per 1000 unmarried people aged 16+, and 7.9 divorces per 1000 married/civil-union couples. Figures retrieved via the Mirage News republication of the Stats NZ release. 2024: 18,033 marriages+CU, 7,497 divorces.
